body.name: Retained-edge sanity specification
body.construction: Set \(D=3\), \(K=1\), \(V=\{1,2,3\}\), and \(S=\{s\}\). Define \(\mathsf G_{\mathrm{san}}\) by the basal selected DAG \(E(G_0)=\{1\to2,1\to s\}\), with vertex \(3\) isolated in the basal DAG, and the direct soft-intervention target \(T_1=\{3\}\). No other basal edge or direct target is present.
